gaps.explanation: No business-type lines in detail[]; the trim holds no enterprise fund schedule. Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes In Net Position (Deficit) - Proprietary Funds p9 (printed p27), columns Parking Facilities Fund / Sewer Revenue Fund / Nonmajor Enterprise Funds (Total Proprietary Funds not used). JSON receipts = operating revenues, charges for services + investment income (loss) + property taxes + gain on sale of capital assets. Parking: 11,416,816 + property taxes 2,196,051 = 13,612,867. Sewer: 211,673,129 + investment income 7,766,384 + gain 9,509 = 219,449,022. Nonmajor: 8,834,109. Sum 241,895,998 = statement total. (Capital contributions 5,690,900 are in business_type.other_financing, not receipts; added under other financing below.)
